keys.note: The seed is committed in the clear and is derived from a published label, so anyone can forge this signature. That is the point: it lets the build/test/promote/verify pipeline execute end to end in tests and CI while every promotion it signs is recorded as DEVELOPMENT class and refused by `verify --release-grade`.
keys.seed_derivation: sha256(b"typedb-r2 release development key -- publicly known, carries no authority")

note: Keys allowed to sign a release evidence root. A 'production' key's seed is NEVER read from this repository - tools/release/release.py requires it from RELEASE_SIGNING_SEED_FILE[_<KEY_ID>] and refuses a world/group readable seed file. There is deliberately NO production key here yet: release-grade promotion is therefore structurally impossible today, which is the true state of this repository (round-6 R6-QUAL-01), not a gap in the tool. Adding one is an owner action that must land with the ledger entry naming the holder, the storage of the seed, and the rotation procedure.
